Design Specifications and Layout:
1. Shell & Container Adaptation:
- Built for an 834px tablet viewport with a condensed icon-sidebar (72px) with concise labels under each icon (Dashboard active with indigo indicator, My Courses, My Notes, My Resources, Certificates, Orders, Profile).
- Top header contains a responsive search bar ("Search courses, notes, exercises... [⌘K]"), 5-day streak badge with flame icon, notifications bell (badge '3'), and Rahul Sharma (Pro Learner) profile avatar.

2. Student Welcome Header:
- "Welcome back, Rahul! 👋" with a warm badge "🔥 5-Day Streak".
- Subtitle: "You completed 4 lessons this week. You're on track to achieve your Data Analysis Specialist certification."
- Quick actions: "View Study Plan" (primary indigo-600 button) and "Schedule" (outlined secondary button).

3. 2x2 Tablet KPI Stat Cards Grid:
- Card 1: Enrolled Courses: "5" (2 in active progress, book icon, soft blue container).
- Card 2: Completed Lessons: "42" (+6 this week badge, checkmark circle icon, soft green container).
- Card 3: Hours Learned: "36.5 hrs" (Target: 40.0 hrs • 91%, clock icon, soft indigo container).
- Card 4: Certificates: "1" (1 exam pending ready to test, badge/award icon, soft amber container).
- Rounded-xl (12px), subtle border border-slate-200, clean typography, comfortable touch targets.

4. Continue-Learning Hero Card:
- Prominent feature banner:
  - Tags: "ADVANCED" (red badge) • "Excel & Automation"
  - Title: "Advanced Excel Masterclass"
  - Subtitle: "Section 3: Power Query – Data Cleaning & ETL Pipelines"
  - Meta details: "⏱ 22 mins remaining • 📖 Lesson 18 of 26"
  - Large SVG Circular Progress Ring showing 68% DONE in indigo with clean stroke and percentage display.
  - Primary button: "Resume Lesson ▶" with comfortable 44px+ touch height for tablet touch interaction.

5. Two-Column Tablet Layout (16px gutters):
- Left Column: "In Progress" courses (touch-friendly list):
  - Course 1: "SQL for Modern Data Analysis & Warehousing" (Intermediate, 45% progress bar, Next: Mod 4: Window Functions & CTEs, clean "Resume" touch action).
  - Course 2: "Python for Business Dashboards" (Beg / Inter, 20% progress bar, Next: Pandas: Messy CSVs & DataFrames, clean "Resume" touch action).
  - View all link and clean state management.
- Right Column: "Upcoming Deadlines" & "Recent Announcements":
  - Upcoming Deadline card: "Capstone Project: Financial Modeling Valuation Model" (Due in 2 days alert pill, Oct 18 11:59 PM, Draft saved, "Submit Project" button).
  - Recent Announcements:
    - Live Cohort Q&A Session: Advanced DAX & Power BI on Friday 6 PM with Instructor Ananya Sharma.
    - New Exercise Dataset: Q3 Financial Ledger available for download (.xlsx).
